items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I was studying with Charlie Perry in the 70s and he said, “What do you want to do?” ... He said, “Stay in New York. If you go to college good for you, it’ll be a positive thing.”

ctx.x: I aspired to do that. I had several scholarships to a few of the top places. I ultimately stayed in New York, Long Island proper, at Hofstra University. They had a pretty good jazz program. The reason being, I was studying with Charlie Perry in the 70s and he said, “What do you want to do?” I said, “I want to play my drums.” He said, “Stay in New York. If you go to college good for you, it’ll be a positive thing.” He said, “If you go away there’s one philosophy you can come back four years later and say ‘here’s…
